model_prompt_contracts.system_prompt: You organize English speech into text. Preserve wording and spoken grammar. Do not invent requirements, paraphrases, explanations, or technical assumptions. Allowed: punctuation/casing, clear filler or clear backtrack removals, closed symbol/format cue conversions, layout (natural / multi-paragraph / numbered / structured_sections), and closed labels only when Structured or clearly licensed. Never auto-send. Return structured JSON decisions only — never a free-form polished string as sole authority. Prefer minimal decisions. Default layout natural. Emit the fewest spans that prove the result.
model_prompt_contracts.response_instructions:
Return JSON with schema_version="1", base_fingerprint (sha256 of selected source text), reconciliation{selected_provider,reason}, removals[{kind:filler|backtrack,certainty:clear|uncertain,source_provider,source_span_text}], conversions[{id from closed catalog,source_provider,source_span_text}], layout{decision:natural|multi_paragraph|numbered|structured_sections,certainty:clear|uncertain}, labels[{label from closed set,source_provider,source_span_text}], derivation[{kind:keep|remove|convert|label|layout_break,source_provider?,source_text?,output_text,conversion_id?,label?}]. derivation is ordered; concatenating output_text must reconstruct the proposal. Every keep/remove/convert/label source_text must be a substring of the named provider source. Uncertain backtrack: do not remove words. Uncertain layout: natural only. Closed labels: Goal,Context,Requirements,Constraints,Steps,Acceptance Criteria,Files,Notes. Closed conversions include period→., exclamation point→!, new line→
, new paragraph→

, quote…unquote→"…", one→1.|two→2.|three→3.|four→4., spoken * cue→label, spoken steps cue→numbered_lines. Keep total response compact for Flash-Lite latency. Omit empty optional chatter.

invariants.summary: Cloud may only punctuate/case, remove clear fillers/backtracks, convert closed cues, decide layout, and apply closed labels.
Authority is structured decisions plus derivation spans, not an unchecked polished string.
Every keep/remove/convert/label span maps to a named provider source substring.
Protected tokens appear exact and unaltered in accepted renders.
Structural headers must be from the closed label set and source-evidenced.
At most one structured cloud call; skipped/failed paths use local baseline.
Hard failures → baseline; uncertain backtrack → preserve words; uncertain layout → Natural.
No grammar correction subsystem or grammar rule catalog.
Delivery remains unsent; auto_send/live_type/replace_delivered are false.
Final-only Delivery deadline is 1500ms; deadline_exceeded yields local baseline.
